Ben —

Thanks for pulling this. Short summary from CS: 

- Stage: Negotiation (final commercial terms). Technical trial completed 2/16 and integration smoke tests passed.
- Open blockers: SSO & data-retention language (security has asked for a small addendum); procurement is asking for a 12-month price cap clause.
- Decision timeline: OptiHealth execs are aligned to review pricing on Monday 3/1; legal turnaround expected 3–5 business days thereafter.

My recommended forecast treatment: probability 70% (we use this as our committed probability in the forecast deck) — best-case $95k, weighted commit $66.5k. If finance needs a stricter committed number today I can mark 50% but I think 70% reflects the sales signal.

I can follow up with Ashley (Procurement) and push the SOW/Ops redline to legal today.

—Monica
